## LoadOptions.scanCache property

Reuse `.koatty/scan-cache.json` to skip `globby` when nothing changed. Default: true. Also disabled by `KOATTY_DISABLE_SCAN_CACHE=1`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
scanCache?: boolean;
```
